formulas.validation: per-class recall of nearest-prototype classification (squared Euclidean, candidates = client's classes) on the shared validation split using the global model's embeddings
formulas.consistency: (cos(client_prototype, reference_prototype) + 1) / 2; reference = unweighted mean of all clients' same-class prototypes (self-inclusive)
formulas.stability: mean over consecutive attested client-local snapshots of (cos + 1) / 2

config.validation_scope: shared global validation split (no client-specific validation data exists); scores describe each client's PROTOTYPES in the global model's embedding space, not a client-trained model
config.reference_definition: unweighted self-inclusive mean over clients holding the class

training_history.note: history holds scalar losses for participating clients only; non-participation is not instability and scalar losses are not the documented stability evidence

evidence.stability_conclusion: unavailable: no attested client-local prototype snapshots exist; global-model checkpoints are not client history

phase6_readiness.rule: Phase 6 may combine components only for records with complete == true; null values must never be replaced with 0, 1, or a neutral constant
